desc:
This game is currently on a hiatus due to some mental health troubles. Apologies!

Let's Go Golfing! is a 2.5D golf game, where rules are made to be broken, and courses are beyond irregular.
Can be played singleplayer, or up to 8 golfers in multiplayer.

Based off of the Super Stickman Golf series by Noodlecake Games

This game is in Open Beta! New content will be released via updates, if you encounter bugs, or have feedback, please provide it by sending a message to the developer, or through the linked communications server (Only available to 13+)
